chapters.s: Amid the evidence collected year after year in his notebook, Satyavrat Mehta finally approaches a decision. Satyavrat placed the notebook in a secure location and began quietly waiting for the right opportunity. He knew that when the truth emerged, it would emerge with hard evidence.…

Teacher Ananya and engineer Nand meet for the first time while working on a shared village project. From that day, Nand and Ananya worked side by side, bringing every old page, every lost name, every folk song back to life. Neither understood yet that they were becoming witnesses to Budhba’s final chapter—and that the…

The fraud network run by Lau Kin-Hung, in its full reach, draws close to Garh Narikel. After hearing him, Ananya began warning every young person in the village again—asking what promise was coming from afar and what web might be hidden behind its glitter.…

Batuknath finally gives his legal skill wholly to the service of a dark power. Remembering Budhba’s words, Nand entered Batuknath’s story in his archive without hatred and without pardon, simply as truth—from the brilliant child to the lawyer in darkness, the whole journey.…

Chandrapal Batra, drowning in gambling debt, becomes a “mule account” for the fraud network. After hearing this, Satyavrat began gathering his evidence with still greater care. He knew the time was drawing near when the entire network would be exposed, and he understood that on that day his old notebook…

In his engineering work, Nand is assigned to a new bridge-construction site, where the seed of the coming story is planted. After hearing this, Nand took extra care for worker safety at the site, writing every labourer’s name in his diary, asking after them, and arguing with the contractor for their protection.…

Gop Kumar draws near to giving final form to the archival work of his entire life. After hearing Budhba, Gop Kumar worked still faster to give the collection its final form. He knew time was short, and he now understood that this lifetime’s work would become the foundation on which Nand would stand…

Budhba, together with the whole Channa Grove, feels the tremor of an approaching event. The villagers remained gathered near Channa Grove that night, not knowing what they were waiting to see, but knowing that something important was close.…

Budhba gives Nand a special blessing and warning for the role ahead of him. Holding Budhba’s words in his heart, Nand returned home. He lay awake for a long time that night, hearing the words again and again: “You will not be alone.” He did not know that the next day his life…

chapters.t: The First Splash at the Bridge
chapters.s: At the bridge-construction site, the accident Budhba had sensed year after year finally occurs. From that night on, Nand gave his life to searching for the labourer’s name and the names of others like him—workers who disappeared unnamed, whose reckoning no one kept.…

After the labourer’s death at the bridge, Nand and Satyavrat meet in the search for truth by different roads. From that day Nand and Satyavrat investigated together—Nand by following names, Satyavrat by following money. They began matching their evidence, and as the threads joined…

Satyavrat’s evidence, gathered over years, finally reaches the court and the media. Hearing all this, Nand threw himself into carrying the evidence further and making sure the truth reached everyone in the village. He knew the fight was not over…

Amid the investigation and his grief, Nand for the first time experiences Budhba dimly with his own eyes. From then on Nand heard Budhba’s voice more clearly than before—sometimes in the wind, sometimes in the rustling leaves, sometimes in the inner voice that separated right from wrong.…

Having completed the collection of his entire life, Gop Kumar hands it to Nand and Ananya. A few months later Gop Kumar died peacefully, but his collection remained safe in the hands of Nand and Ananya. That night, it is said, a faint rustling rose from every root of Channa Grove—as though Budhba…

Through the combined efforts of Satyavrat and Nand, the entire fraud network—at least in its local form—is exposed. Hearing all this, Nand chose not to see the incomplete victory as defeat, but as one step. He safeguarded his evidence, his diary, every name—for the day when someone else might use the seed he had left and bring even…

In his diary “The Reckoning of the Splash,” Nand finally completes the names of every victim of the bridge accident. That night Nand sat for a long time beneath the pipal, holding the diary against his chest. He understood that he had not merely written thirty names—he had carried Budhba’s twelve-hundred-year vow forward into his own…

With Nand, Budhba reflects for the last time on his entire journey. On that new-moon night, every root, leaf, and branch of Channa Grove trembled with the refrain of those names, as though every person of all those centuries had returned for a single moment.…

With every young person of the village, Nand and Ananya promise to carry Budhba’s ritual forward. After the pledge the village slowly dispersed, but something had changed. The burden that had once belonged only to Budhba, and then to Gop Kumar, had become the burden of a whole generation.…

Budhba gives Nand the final secret of the twelve-hundred-year prehistory and senses that the story is approaching the author and reader beyond the stage. Part 0 ends by transferring the burden of witness from the ancient guardian to the next generation rather than closing the narrative.
